[[Wieshur's Inspiration]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Wieshur the Inspiring]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Domain of Secrets]].

==Stats==
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Inspiration Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Inspiration Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Crystal Wand]], [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Crystal Wand]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Memory]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription#Hale and Hearty|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription
*White [[dye]]

**[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription#Hale and Hearty|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription

*One of the following [[Inspiration Magic]] [[wand]]s:
